thread:
kevin: Heads-up: external pentest arrives Tues 04/14. Want to lock down plan for RBAC snapshots, audit slices, KMS evidence flow, and the retest gating rules. Quick alignment?
tara: +1. Main constraints: minimal blast radius, no production key material out, and all accesses must be auditable. Propose a 3-phase window: dry-run (1h), active testing (3h), wrap/debrief (30m).
lucas: Sounds good. For RBAC we'll create a dedicated pen-test tenant in staging with mirrored policies. We'll export role-policy mapping and a policy-diff script so triage can see changes.
kevin: Export format: CSV for roles and JSON for policies. Put both under s3://redwood-pt-archive/<thread_ts>/ and enable object-level logging.
tara: KMS flow: do NOT share master keys. Create an ephemeral wrapping key (alias/pt-wrapper-2026-04-14) that will be used to rewrap evidence bundles only. Only the decrypt role will be granted kms:Decrypt for the exact object prefix during the window. Revoke immediately after.
lucas: Implementation note: grant via KMS CreateGrant with Constraint on aws:RequestTag/pen_test_id and PrincipalTag. We can script it. Example: 

aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-wrapper-2026-04-14 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/pt-decrypt --operations Decrypt --name "pen-test-1748889999" --retiring-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/pt-admin

Add automation to retire/grant by ops-bot.
ops-bot: queued: create-grant job for alias/pt-wrapper-2026-04-14 at 2026-04-14T09:00:00Z. Will post grant metadata and CloudTrail link.
kevin: Audit capture: we need CloudTrail + S3 access logs + VPC flow logs for the staging subnet slice + any bastion SSH sessions recorded. Provide SOC with an indexed query sample and the tags to filter.
tara: Query examples for SOC: 
- CloudTrail: eventName=AssumeRole AND requestParameters.roleArn="arn:aws:iam::123456:role/pt-decrypt"
- S3 access: bucket=redwood-pt-archive prefix=1748889999/ AND x-amz-request-id exists
- VPC: src=10.1.5.0/24 AND dstPort=22
lucas: For SSH sessions we'll use session-recording (ttyrec) and store under encrypted S3. Access to those files gated by the wrapper key. Note: session recordings include user input, redact before sharing.
kevin: Vulnerability intake + remediation tracker: create a single Jira project PT-REMED with custom fields: severity (Critical/Major/Minor), exploitability (Proof/Exploit), retest_needed (boolean), triage_owner, evidence_links (s3 url list). Add automation: when triage_owner marks fix_done -> auto-assign retest request form to vendor.
tara: Add acceptance tests: each fix must include a replayable test case (cURL or script) and the environment snapshot id. Without that, retest not allowed.
lucas: Retest scheduling: reserve two 2-hour windows within 7 days post-engagement. Vendor picks one; internal triage team must confirm fixes 24h before slot. If not confirmed, slot auto-cancels.
kevin: Incident response tie-in: if vendor finds a high-severity (>=Critical) vuln that impacts production, trigger incident-bridge and fast-track a hotfix rollback plan. We'll predefine owners: infra-eng (pager: infra-oncall), security (pager: sec-oncall), product (pager: pm-oncall).
tara: Evidence redaction policy: PII and secrets must be redacted before any external export. We'll use the redaction pipeline: 1) automated scrub (regex for keys, tokens, emails) 2) manual review by security (2 eyes) 3) stamp the artifact with redaction manifest.
kevin: Forensics retention: keep full encrypted artifacts for 90 days with WORM enabled, but exported bundles to vendor limited to 30 days and delete after verified.
lucas: Automation snippets: 
- Grant creation
```
GRANT_ID=$(aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-wrapper-2026-04-14 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/pt-decrypt --operations Decrypt --query GrantId --output text)
aws logs put-log-events --log-group /pt/grants --log-stream ${GRANT_ID} --log-events timestamp=$(date +%s000),message="grant created ${GRANT_ID} by ops-bot"
```
- Revoke job (post-window)
```
aws kms retire-grant --grant-id ${GRANT_ID}
ops-bot post "grant retired: ${GRANT_ID}"
```

kevin: Who owns what?
- RBAC export & policy-diff: lucas
- KMS key + grant lifecycle + scripts: ops-bot (ops)
- Evidence redaction & vendor handoff: tara
- Jira board & triage automation: kevin

lucas: I'll upload initial exports to s3://redwood-pt-archive/1748889999/ and post checksums shortly.
ops-bot: uploaded: rbac.csv (sha256: a1b2...9f), policies.json (sha256: c3d4...7e). object_lock=30d.
kevin: One more: require vendor to use OIDC via their identity provider; no long-lived IAM users. We'll enforce via policy condition on aws:userid and aws:PrincipalTag/partner=true.
tara: Agreed. Also require vendor to run against staging only; deny prod by tag-based deny-list.
vendor-bot: vendor onboarding reminder: complete the vendor attestation form (link) and provide OIDC client ID by EOD 04/10. Failure to provide will delay the test.
kevin: Thanks all. This thread will be the canonical plan; I'll convert action items into the Jira board and ping owners for sign-off. Post any blockers here.
